review_evidence: Core Clap circuit/compiler/cryptographic definitions and theorem-bearing test files were retained, including SHA2 tests and compiler integration examples.

Compiler/Wheels.lean only registers Lean trace classes. KeylessFixture.lean explicitly states it is generated test-fixture data from input_json_to_lean.py and is dominated by large raw byte/vector constants; its hand-written helper module is retained.

rules.content_invariant: Wheels.lean consists only of `Lean.registerTraceClass` initializers. KeylessFixture.lean is explicitly generated from external input JSON and consists primarily of huge byte/vector constants used by retained tests; reusable helper/semantic code remains in KeylessFixtureHelpers.lean and core modules.
evidence: Complete Wheels.lean inspected; KeylessFixture header/generator provenance and generated data body inspected; KeylessFixtureHelpers retained separately.
rules.rationale: These exact files are compiler trace registration and generated bulk test input data, not unique circuit specifications or proofs.

summary: Reviewed clap-lean; formal circuit/compiler material and theorem-bearing tests remain searchable, while trace registration and one generated bulk test-data fixture are excluded.
